g.title: Entity Relationship Diagram created by erdantic

a.xlink:title:
lca_models.core.models.ActivityType
Type classification of an activity (e.g. production, market activity, import).
``oriont:ActivityType`` carries the label that specifies what kind of activity a :class:`LCIActivityNode` represents. Linked from :class:`LCIActivityNode` via ``oriont:hasActivityType``.
Attributes: name: Human-readable activity type label (e.g. ``"production"``, ``"market activity"``).

lca_models.core.models.FlowObject
Reference to the entity (substance, service, or energy) exchanged in a Flow.
In ORIONT/BONSAI, a ``FlowObject`` holds the *labels* and identifiers of what flows — e.g. "Carbon dioxide", "Electricity, medium voltage", "Steel, low-alloyed". The ``oriont:Flow`` (``LCIExchange``) carries the *quantity*; this class carries the *identity* of what is quantified.
Linked from :class:`LCIExchange` via ``oriont:hasObjectType``.
Attributes: name: Common name of the substance, service, or energy carrier. cas_number: CAS registry number (optional). category: Primary EF compartment or flow category (e.g. ``"Emission to air"``). sub_category: Secondary compartment (e.g. ``"unspecified"``). synonyms: Alternative names for this flow object.

lca_models.core.models.Inventory
Top-level container for a Life Cycle Inventory (LCI).
Typed as ``lcont:Inventory`` (``rdfs:subClassOf oriont:ProductSystem`` in ``LifeCycleOnto.ttl``) — "Collection of unit processes with elementary and product flows, performing one or more defined functions, and which models the life cycle of a product." (ISO 14040)
Groups together all the :class:`LCIActivityNode` activities that collectively describe the production system under study.
Attributes: name: Human-readable name of the inventory (optional). comment: Free-text comment or provenance note (defaults to ``""``). nodes: List of ``LCIActivityNode`` activities belonging to this inventory.

lca_models.core.models.LCIActivityNode
An activity (process or product) node in an LCI graph.
Attributes: id: Auto-generated UUID for this node. name: Name of the activity / process. unit: Reference unit (e.g. ``"kg"``). type: :class:`ActivityType` classification of this node. location: Geographic location code (defaults to ``"GLO"``). synonyms: Alternative names for the reference product. product_information: Additional descriptive information. comment: Free-text note. summary: Human-readable summary of this activity. exchanges: Input flows consumed by this activity.

lca_models.core.models.LCIExchange
A directed flow between two activities in an LCI graph.
Attributes: id: Stable UUID for this exchange. Preserve this value when transforming between draft and production-grade inventory representations so the same logical flow can be traced. name: Human-readable name of the flow. unit: Unit of measurement (e.g. ``"kg"``, ``"MJ"``). type: Flow type — ``"technosphere"``, ``"biosphere"``, or ``"production"``. amount: Quantity of the exchange. comment: Optional free-text note. from_activity: UUID of the upstream (producing) activity. to_activity: UUID of the downstream (consuming) activity.

lca_models.core.models.Location
Geographic scope of an LCA activity or LCIA run.
``oriont:Location`` identifies the country, region, or market scope of a dataset (e.g. ``"GLO"`` for global, ``"RER"`` for Europe, ``"DE"`` for Germany). Linked from :class:`LCIActivityNode` and :class:`LCIASummary` via ``oriont:hasLocation``.
Attributes: code: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, or an LCA database region code such as ``"GLO"``, ``"RER"``, ``"RNA"``. name: Optional human-readable name of the location.
